observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A nightclub or stage set with tables, checkered tablecloths, and an orchestra performing in the background.
observation.dancers: A large mixed group of men and women, appearing as multiple couples and as a larger ensemble.
observation.formation_and_space: Couples spread out across the dance floor, transitioning into a group line formation facing the audience.
observation.posture: Athletic and upright with an energetic, forward-leaning stance and slightly bent knees.
observation.footwork: Fast-paced stepping and shuffling on the balls of the feet in time with the driving swing rhythm.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms swing naturally, reach outward, or clasping partner hands; sometimes raised overhead.
observation.hips_and_torso: Bending at the waist and twisting torso movements coordinated with footwork.
observation.partnering: Couples alternate between closed dance hold, open hand-to-hand holds, and solo breaks.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent jumps, low crouches close to the floor, and rapid spins.
observation.costume_and_props: Men wear light-colored short-sleeved shirts and dark trousers; women wear light tops with dark skirts.
observation.cannot_infer: Low resolution and fast motion make exact individual weight transfer details difficult to track precisely.

signature_moments.what: Couples break apart from closed hold into fast solo Charleston-style footwork.
Dancers drop down into a low crouch while sweeping their legs.
The group lines up side-by-side, executing synchronized kicks and crouches.
